prose:
"code" is an async JavaScript function body. Top-level await and return are supported. The top-level return value becomes result; the run header and logs are diagnostics.

The TypeScript declarations below are documentation only; do not paste type annotations into code. Call bundled tools only through tools.name(args), with exactly one argument object. A code suite keeps its namespace even with one member: tools.suite.member(args). Other LiteCode tools may remain directly callable outside this SDK.

Every resolved call has a boolean ok. When ok is false, reason and message describe a domain failure, so one bad item need not end a batch. Unknown tools and extra JavaScript arguments throw TypeError; invalid tool arguments resolve ok:false invalid_args, and unknown fields are never silently dropped. Non-finite result numbers (NaN / Infinity) become null with a header warning. For command tools, ok means the call completed; inspect exit_code for the process status. Start a job with run_in_background:true, then use its id with wait/kill while exit_code is null. Cancellation, the run_code budget, and hard limits end the program and cannot be caught.

libs are deterministic pure-JS helpers (no filesystem, network, or process). fs.ls / fs.stat / fs.exists are synchronous, read-only workspace probes; mutate files only through declared tools. The sandbox has no setTimeout / setInterval.

Unhandled Promise rejections do not end the program; a [warn] notes them after settle.

types.Integer:
/** Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values. @asType integer */
type Integer = number;
types.Path:
/** Workspace-relative path, or an absolute path when explicitly allowed. */
type Path = string;
types.RunData:
/** run returns ok for a resolved call; exit_code carries the command status. */
type RunData = CommandData;

read.doc: Read lines from one file or archived session transcript.

write.doc: Replace a file's contents; optional hash and create-only guards.

code_search.doc: Semantic search over the workspace code index.

kill.doc: Terminate a command job in this session.

run.doc: Start one shell command; use run_in_background for a non-blocking job.

wait.doc: Wait for a still-running command job; exit_code is the command status.

memory.delete.doc: Delete entries by id from the current session's working memory.

memory.list.doc: List the current session's working memory.

memory.upsert.doc: Add or update small, durable session memory entries.

browser_click.doc: Click one interactive element on the visible page.

browser_read.doc: Read the current visible browser page.

browser_type.doc: Type text into one input on the visible page.

diagnostics.doc: List diagnostics for one source file.

document_symbol.doc: List symbols in one source file.

find_references.doc: List references at a file position.

go_to_definition.doc: Jump to definition at a file position.

go_to_implementation.doc: Jump to implementations at a file position.

hover.doc: Fetch hover docs or type information at a file position.
